backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only latest FINRA rows whose publication date is on or before the signal date plus OHLCV known after the signal-date close; paper entry is the next available open with production entry slippage; exit is ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: high published short-interest pressure can amplify liquid breakouts through squeeze/covering demand, but only when price/volume/RS already confirm.

2_history_check.exp-20260505-024: FINRA days-to-cover was joined as a shadow overlay only; it did not run a three-window paper candidate-pool replay.
2_history_check.exp-20260506-free-short-pressure: Added SEC FTD/Nasdaq threshold as shadow context only; no default-off paper candidate source was tested.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-037_and_exp-20260529-001: OHLCV-only accumulation/VWAP candidate pools failed; this run adds an orthogonal official short-interest field instead of retuning a price pattern.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; no EV- or PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: FINRA publication-lag short-interest pressure plus OHLCV breakout confirmation may create a free-data default-off candidate pool.
interpretation: The FINRA short-pressure breakout candidate pool did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby short-pressure breakout thresholds on the same frozen windows without forward rows or a stronger borrow-cost/availability field.
next_evidence_needed: Forward replacement-value rows or a materially stronger free/cheap short-pressure field, such as borrow fee, borrow availability, or float-normalized short interest.

finra_score_definition.same_day_universe: current fixed-window stock universe with a published FINRA row on or before the signal date

source_definition: latest FINRA short-interest row must be published on or before the signal date
short-pressure score must be at least 0.70
stock ticker only; ETFs and benchmark/theme proxies excluded
top-1 selected paper entry per signal date

prediction.confidence_reason: FINRA short interest is an orthogonal free PIT source, but the publication lag and recent candidate-pool failures lower confidence.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off FINRA paper adapter with cached source rows, exact OHLCV as-of guards, and parity tests before any daily report or live/default behavior changes.

production_parity.parity_note: No production code path is changed. If accepted, promotion requires a shared default-off paper adapter and exact publication-date/as-of OHLCV parity tests.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay attribution remains sparse. Skipped Companyfacts, VBB, VCP, state-surface, SEC 8-K, and OHLCV pattern-name retunes per playbook freeze guidance. This run tests one free official FINRA short-interest candidate-source variable.
